description: Report a figure that looks wrong or a data problem you noticed (at most 10 reports per day per caller). Give the tool and arguments of the call in question and describe the problem in message (up to 2,000 characters). Returns a report id; the text is stored for review by the operator and is never shown to other users. Use it only after checking the figure; not for questions or feature requests. Look at get_catalog or the notes of an answer first: gaps and non-comparable periods are often documented there.

args.description: The arguments of that call (at most 4 KB as JSON).

message.description: What looks wrong, with the figure, month and what you expected.

tool.description: Name of the tool whose answer looked wrong, e.g. "get_series".

name: report_data_issue
